rules.statement: An action for the recall of probate cannot be brought by summary procedure under section 537 of the Civil Procedure Code where an order nisi declaring a will proved has been made absolute, and interested parties must bring an independent action to set aside the judgment if fraud is alleged.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiffs, who were not parties to the testamentary action, sue for the recall of the probate of the will of Ran Etana granted to her husband, the defendant. The ground of action assigned in the plaint is that the will produced in Court 'was not the act and deed of Vithanage Ran Etana.'"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: "Section 537 of the Civil Procedure Code lays down the procedure for the recall or revocation of probate. Sections 536 and 537 should not be read together. Section 537 is not limited to the grounds of recall specified in section 536, but it was intended to permit applications for recall of probate on any legal ground."
